story_text:
Interface is a ring with one button: press it, talk, and your words become a note, a message or a request to your AI agents, without taking out your phone. It works with NatureOS on iPhone and Android, and with your Mac or Windows computer.
## Why we built it
Phones gave us everything, and took our attention in return. We wanted the opposite: technology you can use while staying in the moment. So we put the most useful things you do with your phone behind one button on your finger.
## How it works
Whisper in a waiting room, or speak up at a concert. When it's very quiet or very loud, bring the ring close to your lips. The rest of the time, just talk with your hand wherever it is.
## Health and sleep
Interface reads your heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, sleep, skin temperature and activity, day and night. Log what you eat, your workouts, your supplements and how you feel, and your AI pairs it with your biometrics to give you insights made for you.
## Dictation and AI agents
Your agents use your apps for you. Ask, and the agent you chose does the work. Anything that matters waits for your approval, and in NatureOS you choose which apps each agent can use.
## Notes and meetings
Catch a thought before it's gone. Dictate an idea, a reminder or a name, and find it later in NatureOS, or let your agents organize it for you.
Record a meeting and get the full transcript, who said what, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Later, just ask what you decided. The light on the ring shows when it's recording.
## HumanPods
Talk to your agents through HumanPods while your phone stays in your pocket. Ask a question, start a task or hear an update. With Interface, press the ring and ask, and hear the reply in your HumanPods.
## Rewards
## The ring
All of this lives in one ring of stainless steel, brushed, with polished edges, made to be worn every day.
Worn on your index finger, with the button facing your thumb. Waterproof.
## Privacy and NatureOS
Interface only records while you press the button, and a light shows when it does. Nothing is recorded without your approval.
NatureOS is where your agents live: tasks, chats and notes in one place, and you decide what each agent can reach.
## Tech specs
## Timeline
Rings ship in February 2027.
## Everything in one ring
## The team
We're Natura, from the creators of Rolling Square, based in Lugano, Switzerland. Across 20 crowdfunding campaigns, more than 169,000 backers have supported our products, rated 4.4 on Trustpilot.
risks: Rolling Square has run crowdfunding campaigns for years, and Interface is our most complex product yet: a microphone, sensors, a battery and a vibration motor inside a stainless steel ring. Our H54 prototypes have passed battery, charging, Bluetooth and electrical-safety tests. Water-resistance, drop and heat tests are next, and health tracking and voice capture in noisy places are still being validated. We'll confirm each one in a backer update before shipping, and we won't ship claims we can't stand behind. Agent features depend on third-party AI services that can change. If an integration changes, we'll tell you. If anything changes on timing, you'll hear it from us first, with the reason and the new date.

faq.a: No. It records only while you press and hold the button, or after you double-click to record a meeting. A discreet light makes recording visible.
Press and hold the button, speak, then let go. To record a meeting, double-click to start and double-click again to stop.

faq.q: How does the result come back?
faq.a: Depending on the task, you hear a reply in your headphones, follow an update on your iPhone lock screen, or open the full result in NatureOS. Anything that needs approval asks you first.

faq.q: Which finger do I wear it on?
faq.a: Your index finger, with the button facing your thumb.

Yes. Interface pairs with your iPhone over Bluetooth Low Energy, and NatureOS does the work. Without your phone nearby, the ring still records and stores up to 2 hours of audio, and syncs it at the next connection.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: 6 to 12 days per charge, estimated for typical daily use. With one hour of recording a day, about 5 to 6 days. Continuous recording is about 13 hours, calculated from the power draw we measured on our prototypes and excluding audio transfer. Charging takes 75 minutes to 80% and 107 minutes to full, measured on our prototypes. The charging case recharges the ring on the go.

faq.q: Can I wear it in the shower?
faq.a: Yes. Interface is waterproof: showers and swimming are fine. We’ll test and announce the official IP rating before shipping.
Sleep, heart rate, heart-rate variability (HRV), blood oxygen (SpO2) and activity. These features are being validated, and we’ll confirm the final list in a backer update before shipping.

faq.q: How is it different from other smart rings?
faq.a: Other rings track your health. Interface is designed to do that too, and adds a button and a microphone, so the ring you wear every day also captures your ideas, writes for you and gets things done.

faq.q: Can I whisper to it, or use it somewhere loud?
faq.a: Interface is designed for both. Bring the ring close to your mouth and speak quietly when you need to be discreet, or bring it closer in a loud place. Whisper performance and noise handling are in validation; we will share the results in a backer update.

faq.q: What do I get from a recorded meeting?
faq.a: The meeting is saved in NatureOS with the full transcript, each speaker identified, and a recap with decisions and next steps. Tell the people in the room before you record; the light on the ring shows when recording is on.
No. HumanPods are optional. They provide an in-ear way to receive audio results.

Your reward includes 3 months of Membership. After that, Membership is optional and costs $9/month. Health tracking (sleep, heart rate, HRV, SpO2, activity) stays free, with no subscription. Membership covers the AI features: transcription, notes, meeting recaps, AI agents and proactive work.
